messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Good news, John, that one's your replacement order.

Your NerdQX reached our Chattanooga warehouse today, October 22. Shop···· holds one Hammer Thor P2, reserved at that same warehouse, and it was held only until the faulty unit landed. That gate has now cleared, so it goes to packing and you'll get the tracking by email as soon as the label prints.

Nothing owed on it, the order sits at $0.00. Anything else you want me to check while I'm in here?
It was my understanding that I would need to pay 79.01, the difference between the nerdQx I bought previously and the Thor P2. Please tell me how to make that payment?

Nothing to pay, John. Shop···· was set up as a no-cost replacement, it reads paid with a $0.00 balance, and no invoice for the difference sits on it. So there's no payment to make and nothing holding the shipment.

I've asked Abel and Georges to confirm the $79.01 was waived on their side, since you were told to expect it. They'll come back to you here or by email. Either way, don't send anything until one of them confirms.
